title: CI pipeline (typecheck, lint, test, build, security scan, contract-lock check)
goal: Every pull request runs typecheck, lint, tests, build, dependency/secret scanning and the contract-lock check, and cannot merge if any fails.
scope_in: GitHub Actions workflow ci.yml: install (frozen lockfile, pnpm cache), typecheck, lint, unit tests with coverage, build, with Node 22; a service-container job (postgres:16, redis:7) for integration tests.
security.yml: `pnpm audit --prod` (fail on high/critical), gitleaks secret scan, CodeQL for JavaScript/TypeScript, licence allow-list check (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC).
Contract-lock job: runs `python3 tools/plan/lock.py --check` and fails on any diff to contracts/ or contracts/CONTRACTS.lock.
Lane-ID PR title check (`^B\d{3}: `) and PR template per plan/PR_TEMPLATE.md; CODEOWNERS file.
Dependabot config limited to security updates; required status check names documented.
scope_out: Deployment pipelines and Terraform checks (later infra lanes).
Writing the lock tool itself (shared tooling in tools/plan/); this lane only calls it.
build_against: Test the workflows locally with `act` or by pushing to a scratch branch; to test the lock job, edit any contracts/ file on a throwaway branch and confirm the job fails.
interfaces: Required status checks: `ci / typecheck`, `ci / lint`, `ci / test`, `ci / build`, `ci / contract-lock`, `security / audit`, `security / secrets`, `security / codeql`, `pr-title`.
`node tools/ci/check-licences.mjs` exits 1 listing any production dependency whose licence is not on the allow-list.
`node tools/ci/check-lane-title.mjs "<title>"` exits 0 only for titles like `B037: relay service skeleton`.
acceptance: A PR that modifies any byte of contracts/ fails the `ci / contract-lock` check within 2 minutes.
A PR whose title does not match `^B\d{3}: ` fails `pr-title`.
A PR adding a production dependency licensed GPL-3.0 fails the licence step of `security / audit`; an MIT one passes.
A commit containing a string shaped like an AWS secret key fails `security / secrets`.
The full ci workflow completes in under 10 minutes on the empty workspace, with the pnpm store cached on the second run.
The integration job exposes `DATABASE_URL` and `REDIS_URL` to tests and the postgres service passes its health check before tests start.
Workflow permissions are `contents: read` by default; no workflow uses `pull_request_target`.
tests: Dry-run: scratch-branch PR with a contracts/ edit proves the lock job fails (recorded in docs/ci.md).
guardrails: MUST NOT use `pull_request_target` or expose secrets to workflows triggered from forks.
MUST pin every third-party action to a full commit SHA and set minimal `permissions:` per job.
MUST NOT let the contract-lock job be skipped or marked continue-on-error.
MUST NOT cache anything containing secrets or .env files.
failure_modes: Flaky service container start -> job waits on health checks (max 60 s) then fails with the container log attached, never silently skips integration tests.
Audit service unreachable -> job fails closed (red) with a documented manual re-run, not green.
Lock tool missing from the repo -> job fails with a message naming tools/plan/lock.py.
notes: Consumes every contract only through the lock check. Planning tooling (tools/plan/lock.py, contracts/CONTRACTS.lock) is shared; this lane assumes both ship in the backend repo.
